categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Rianlong New Materials Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: polymer material anti-aging additives, lubricant additives, and life sciences. The polymer anti-aging segment is the core business, providing a full range of anti-aging products and application technologies. The lubricant additives segment, developed through strategic acquisition, offers a comprehensive product line serving various industries. The life sciences segment focuses on bioblocks and synthetic biology, including nucleic acid drug raw materials and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in polymer anti-aging additives, including antioxidants, light stabilizers, and customized compound products (U-pack®). It has developed innovative production processes protected by numerous patents. In lubricant additives, it employs advanced synthesis and formulation technologies for functional single and compound additives. The life sciences segment utilizes modern synthetic biology and molecular biology techniques, with established platforms for nucleic acid synthesis and modification. The recent acquisition of Korean IPITECH INC. brings advanced electronic-grade polyimide (PI) material technologies, enhancing capabilities in flexible OLED displays and semiconductor packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Rianlong serves a broad range of downstream industries including plastics, coatings, rubber, fibers, adhesives, automotive, construction, electronics, transportation, manufacturing, steel, pharmaceuticals, power, and precision electronics. Its polymer anti-aging products cater to global polymer material manufacturers, while lubricant additives serve domestic and international oil companies and industrial clients. The life sciences segment targets pharmaceutical companies and research institutions involved in nucleic acid drug development and diagnostics. The company has a significant customer base domestically and internationally, with exports to over 20 countries, especially in the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates multiple production bases across China, including Tianjin, Ningxia Zhongwei, Zhejiang Changshan, Guangdong Zhuhai, Hebei Hengshui, Inner Mongolia Chifeng, and Liaoning Jinzhou. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Hong Kong, the United States, Germany, Japan, Dubai, and Korea, supporting a global marketing and supply network. The recent acquisition of Korean IPITECH INC. expands its footprint in South Korea. The company plans to build overseas production bases, including a new facility in Malaysia, to support international market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Rianlong operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical and materials supply chain, focusing on the research, development, production, and sale of chemical additives and specialty materials. It provides key functional additives that enhance the performance and durability of polymer materials and lubricants, serving as a critical supplier to downstream manufacturers and end-users. The company also extends upstream into life sciences raw materials and electronic-grade materials, integrating R&D and production capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in polymer anti-aging additives, lubricant additives, and life sciences. It invests heavily in R&D with a team of over 400 researchers and maintains a robust patent portfolio. Strategic priorities include developing low-cost, differentiated, and environmentally friendly products, expanding electronic-grade polyimide materials for flexible electronics, and advancing nucleic acid drug raw materials. The company pursues global expansion, digital transformation including AI-driven operations, and sustainability initiatives aligned with carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Rianlong generates revenue primarily through the sale of chemical products and additives, including antioxidants, light stabilizers, lubricant additives, and life science raw materials. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales (over 90%) and some distribution channels. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance or export customs clearance for international sales. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Rianlong is a leading domestic player and one of the two global companies offering a full range of polymer anti-aging additives. It competes with international giants like BASF in the polymer additives market and with global lubricant additive leaders such as Lubrizol, Infineum, Chevron Oronite, and Afton Chemical. In lubricant additives, its subsidiary Jinzhou Kangtai is among the top three domestic private enterprises. The company is advancing in life sciences and electronic-grade materials to establish a competitive position in emerging high-tech fields.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Rianlong achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 5.69 billion, a 7.74% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 426 million, up 17.61%. The company has maintained a compound annual growth rate of 24.59% in revenue over 14 years. It operates with total assets exceeding RMB 9.13 billion and net assets of RMB 4.46 billion. The company continues to invest in capacity expansion and strategic acquisitions, supporting sustained growth and internationalization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Rianlong offers comprehensive, high-quality, and technologically advanced polymer anti-aging additives with a full product line and customized solutions (U-pack®) that precisely meet customer needs, enhancing material durability and sustainability. Its lubricant additives provide one-stop solutions with strong technical support and broad product coverage. The life sciences segment leverages cutting-edge synthetic biology and nucleic acid chemistry to supply critical raw materials for innovative drugs and diagnostics. The recent acquisition of advanced electronic-grade PI materials enables the company to address domestic gaps and support emerging flexible electronics markets. The company emphasizes global supply stability, dual production bases, and integrated services to create strong customer loyalty and competitive barriers.
